name: hxn-gpu
description: One GPU API for Haxe over the hxn GPU drivers: Metal, Vulkan, Direct3D 12, OpenGL ES, WebGPU and WebGL2, with features and limits per device
releasenote: In a threaded hxcpp build in a browser, await works on what the GPU settles. Needs hxn 0.3.6, hxn-gpu-webgpu 0.3.2 and hxn-gpu-webgl2 0.3.1.
